# selfbuild workload v1 -- FROZEN 2026-07-05. Do not edit this list; a new
# workload is a new file (selfbuild-workload-v2.txt) and a new README column
# regime. Numbers measured against different workload versions are not
# comparable.
#
# Source content is pinned by the WORKLOAD tree checkout (see perf-lab.yml
# PERF_LAB_SELFBUILD_WORKLOAD_SHA = 820ff02b98af9dda4eb8094322347ab458de351e,
# the fork point / last upstream commit, pure upstream GCC 14.4.1-prerelease),
# NOT by the stage under test. Every path below was verified to exist at both
# the fork point (820ff02b9) and the current fork tip (5c426dfdd).
#
# Composition: all 16 libcpp/*.cc at the pinned SHA, plus 25 heavyweight gcc/
# files (picked by host-object size in a real build of this fork, plus the
# canonical front/middle-end heavies). Generated sources (insn-*.cc,
# gimple-match-*.cc, ...) are deliberately excluded: they live only in build
# trees, not in the source workload.
#
# Format: one path per line, relative to the workload source tree.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
